channel.title: GeoPulse. Geopolitics in brief
channel.description: Signal-first briefings on geopolitics, edited by Lavkesh Dwivedi.

item.title: Venezuela después del pacto petrolero con EE. UU.
item.description: La administración Trump ha anunciado un acuerdo con Caracas que, según dice, otorga a EE. UU. una participación importante en la industria petrolera venezolana. En esta sesión de preguntas y respuestas, los expertos de Crisis Group Phil Gunson y Delaney Simon analizan las repercusiones de dicho acuerdo. Venezuela después del pacto petrolero con EE.

item.title: CNN, MS NOW, Politico to sue Trump administration over White House access
item.description: "This morning, we notified the government that we are filing a lawsuit today to protect our First Amendment rights and defend the principle that the government does not decide what the press reports or publishes," says the statement CNN, MS NOW, Politico to sue Trump administration over White House access.

item.title: Russia's ruling pro-Putin party wins wartime election with over 57% of vote, near-complete results
item.description: United Russia won 57. United ‌Russia party won 57.83% of the vote, the Central Election ‌Commission said, up ​from 49.8% which it won ⁠in 2021, the last time an ‌election for the State Duma, the lower house of parliament, was held. Russia's ruling pro-Putin party wins wartime election with over 57% of vote, near-complete results.

item.title: Drones And Desolation: The Long Road To Donetsk's Bilozerske
item.description: RFE/RL’s Ukrainian Service correspondent Maryan Kushnir walked some 20 kilometers to reach the embattled city of Bilozerske, in Ukraine’s Donetsk region, which soldiers say has been effectively destroyed by Russian strikes over the past year. Drones And Desolation: The Long Road To Donetsk's Bilozerske.

item.title: Irish privacy regulator fines Google €403 million over location data processing
item.description: “As ​a result ‌of Google’s failures, individuals could have been unaware that their location was being used to, for ‌example, influence them with ads ​or to infer their interests, and could lose control ⁠over their personal data,” DPC Deputy Commissioner Graham Doyle said Irish privacy regulator fines Google €403 million over location data processing.

item.title: Pro-Putin party keeps grip on parliament, anti-war party gains tiny regional foothold
item.description: With over 95% ‌of the vote counted, Ella Pamfilova, chair of the Central Electoral Commission, said United Russia had won a resounding victory with 57.83%, up from the 49.8% that it won in the last parliamentary election, in 2021 Pro-Putin party keeps grip on parliament, anti-war party gains tiny regional foothold.

item.title: Pakistan ex-PM Imran Khan’s three sisters arrested in Lahore
item.description: The Deputy Commissioner of Lahore on September 20, 2026 passed two separate orders, copies of which were seen by AFP, for the three sisters' 30-day detention under the Maintenance of Public Order law of Punjab province Pakistan ex-PM Imran Khan’s three sisters arrested in Lahore.

item.title: China’s J-36 may soon fly with lasers the US couldn’t master
item.description: Recent revelations from China’s defense industry suggest the long-sought goal of mounting combat lasers onto fighter aircraft may finally be moving from theory to reality. State-owned aerospace contractor Aviation Industry Corporation of China (AVIC) showcased plans for an airborne directed-energy weapon at a defense expo, offering the strongest public indication yet that China is developing [] T China’s J-36 may soon fly with lasers the US couldn’t master.

item.title: ASEAN’s digital payment boom outrunning its scam defenses
item.description: Southeast Asia’s rapid economic integration has long been a celebrated success story, and nowhere is this more evident today than in its retail payment systems. Across the region, central banks are linking their national QR code protocols under the ASEAN Regional Payment Connectivity initiative, enabling friction-free, cross-border digital transactions between citizens of Indonesia, Thailand, Mala ASEAN’s digital payment boom outrunning its scam defenses.

item.title: Banished to alien lands: Trump’s secret deportation deals
item.description: After a plane journey in shackles, an Iranian woman found herself in the middle of Africa in a country she did not know existed. She is one of thousands deported from the US on the back of shadowy deals made with dozens of countries. An in-depth investigation reveals the ‘show of force’ costing American taxpayers millionsNo one would tell the shackled detainees onboard the US immigration plane whe.

item.title: Macron and Carney announce closer France-Canada ties amid Trump tensions
item.description: Two leaders meet in French territory off Canada as Ottawa seeks stronger relations with EU while fighting trade war with USThe leaders of France and Canada have pledged closer ties to grapple with rising geopolitical tensions, climate change and the erosion of democratic values, after ⁠they met in a ⁠French territory off Canada’s Atlantic coast. Macron and Carney announce closer France-Canada ties amid Trump tensions.

item.title: Russia's Parliamentary Vote Ends As Moscow, Kyiv Continue Fighting
item.description: There was no let up in fighting between Russia and Ukraine on September 20, as voters in Russia cast ballots on the final day of parliamentary elections from which a political party calling for peace was excluded. Russia's Parliamentary Vote Ends As Moscow, Kyiv Continue Fighting.

item.title: Michelle Bachelet withdraws from race to become UN secretary general
item.description: Former president of Chile drops out after support collapsed in security council straw poll, leaving seven candidates in contestMichelle Bachelet, a former president of Chile, has withdrawn her candidacy to become the next secretary general of the ⁠UN, ending an attempt ​that had struggled to gain traction among security council members. Michelle Bachelet withdraws from race to become UN secretary general.

item.title: The right to development: Why equity, not charity, is a human right
item.description: Compare two children born in the same year: one in a country with functioning schools, social services, fair elections and a dynamic economy and the other in a nation devastated by poverty, conflict, climate change or corruption. The right to development: Why equity, not charity, is a human right.

item.title: Afghan Minaret Restoration Marks 'Pragmatic' Taliban Approach To Cultural Heritage, Experts Say
item.description: Work is now underway to the restore Afghanistan's Minaret of Jam, which experts say reflects a welcome departure from the icon-smashing rule of the Taliban of the 1990s. The change contrasts with the current Taliban rulers' draconian restrictions on other facets of life in the country. Afghan Minaret Restoration Marks 'Pragmatic' Taliban Approach To Cultural Heritage, Experts Say.

item.title: Russia's Starlink Rival Faces Problems In Orbit And Threats On The Ground
item.description: Russia is racing to build Rassvet, its answer to Starlink, after losing access to the satellite network on the battlefield in Ukraine. But troubled satellites, tight deadlines, and a lack of ground terminals could leave Moscow waiting years. Russia's Starlink Rival Faces Problems In Orbit And Threats On The Ground.

item.title: Why China is pushing back on US warnings over rapid AI development
item.description: Beijing believes slowdown calls aim to lock in US advantage, and is pursuing a different balance between safety and paceAbout two years ago, education entrepreneur Boris But had what he calls a “penny-drop moment” – that, like countless others in China, his company needed to embrace AI before it was made obsolete by it. Why China is pushing back on US warnings over rapid AI development.

item.title: China pairs undersea drone mothership with multidomain war vision
item.description: China is constructing what may be the world’s first dedicated mothership for extra-extra-large uncrewed underwater vehicles (XXLUUVs) at the Hudong-Zhonghua shipyard in Shanghai, multiple outlets reported. Satellite photos show the roughly 200-meter hull features a large internal hangar. likely capable of stowing up to four autonomous submersibles. and an open-bottom stern well-deck fitted [] T China pairs undersea drone mothership with multidomain war vision.

item.title: Trump Signs Russia-Iran Sanctions Bill, Putting New Pressure Tools At His Disposal
item.description: US President Donald Trump signed into law legislation aimed at increasing economic pressure on Russia over its war on Ukraine, including by targeting Moscow's energy revenues as well as countries that continue to buy Russian oil and gas. Trump Signs Russia-Iran Sanctions Bill, Putting New Pressure Tools At His Disposal.

item.title: US-Saudi F-35 fighter deal runs into a China-sized problem
item.description: A potential multi-billion-dollar transfer of advanced US stealth fighters to Saudi Arabia has thrust US Middle East policy into a delicate balancing act between regional deterrence, Israeli air superiority and rising geopolitical skepticism. The US State Department approved a potential US$24.3 billion Foreign Military Sale (FMS) of 48 Lockheed Martin F-35 Lightning II fighter jets [] The post US- US-Saudi F-35 fighter deal runs into a China-sized problem.
